message: So, the other night I was trying my hand at cooking something fancy—let's just say it didn’t go quite as planned. I ended up with a smoke alarm that sounded like a banshee, my cat making a getaway, and me frantically fanning the smoke away with a dish towel. 😅 It was a hilarious reminder that having a solid escape plan is just as important as knowing how to sauté! Sometimes, our best intentions can turn into comedy sketches. Have you had a kitchen mishap that turned into a lesson?
